replies.author: Nebbsy
replies.body:
+1


I like the map think it will be very interesting to play and the team names fit it well. Clouds with the monuments in them is a different idea, its good and bad in some ways.  Defensive players will be able to defend the monuments really well because they can break all the glass, and if u try to bridge they can shoot you off. Making it a stalemate kind of game. On the other hand, the pvp will be nice because the map isn't to big nor to small.
